title: ME=WE Asia Exchange
body: Five countries, five neighborhoods, one question — what stirs when young people are given room to practice community life where they already live?

title: Food Revolution
body: A university garden became a social lab — and a four-year study of how a food system shapes the wellbeing of everyone inside it.

title: UAE Youth Social Innovation Workshop Series
body: Six months in which young people turned something they cared about into a social enterprise prototype — through seriously playful investigation.

title: UAE-Nepal-Connect (UNC) Social Innovation
body: After the 2015 earthquake, youth in two countries built relationships that outlasted the program that introduced them.

title: UNC Documentary
body: A camera followed Nepali youth for two years — not to record the program, but to see what held after it ended.

title: Jungle Jam
body: A residential gathering for young people — creativity, adventure, and honest reflection, away from the noise of everyday life.

title: Shadow Shifter
body: Eighteen young people, two days, and one discovery: the shape of your own shadow can be changed by what you do.

title: Light, Shadow, Shift
body: Two days, one circle of women, and the same question asked a hundred small ways: what do you want to carry, and what are you ready to leave behind?
